svg.aria-label: A fragmentation workstation that runs MORTAR's workflow left to right. A magazine holds a compound set of molecule cards and feeds them one by one; a punch turret carries the four algorithm dies and runs a two-step pipeline, Sugar Removal Utility then Scaffold Generator on its fragments; fragments are sorted into rows that form a horizontal histogram, beside a light table for the overview and a board for the items; a printer issues result cards in MORTAR's export formats.
svg.text: turret indexes to the next die
pipeline step 2 · Scaffold Generator · on step 1's fragments
items · each molecule with its fragments
